nodes.name: mcp_server.py
nodes.summary: Optional stdio MCP server that exposes document search, web search, GitHub connect, and the full chat pipeline to MCP clients.
nodes.languageNotes: Tools are registered on MCPServer and resolve a lazily built ServiceContainer inside the server event loop.

nodes.name: routes.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI router of thin HTTP handlers for chat streaming, sessions, uploads, GitHub, retrieval, and web search.
nodes.languageNotes: Handlers stay thin: FastAPI Depends injects services from the container, and POST /chat/stream serializes pipeline events as SSE.

nodes.name: search_client.py
nodes.summary: Async HTTP clients for Tavily and Serper web search, each with a pooled client and one retry on transient failures.

nodes.name: container.py
nodes.summary: Composition root that constructs every service once, wires constructor dependencies, and exposes FastAPI Depends getters.
nodes.languageNotes: An overrides dict lets tests and the MCP server swap embedders, the LLM client, or other collaborators without reading the environment.

nodes.name: main.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI application factory that configures CORS, mounts the SPA, and owns container startup and shutdown.
nodes.languageNotes: When launched as a script, the module rewrites sys.path so the backend package stays importable and local folders are not treated as top-level modules.

nodes.name: api.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic request and response schemas for sessions, chat, uploads, retrieval, search, GitHub, and health.

nodes.name: artifact.py
nodes.summary: Validates a structured download document and renders it to Markdown, text, Excel, Word, or PDF only when a file is requested.
nodes.languageNotes: File bytes are produced at download time from one validated block document and are not stored on disk.

nodes.name: chat_service.py
nodes.summary: Chat pipeline that routes a turn, checks the semantic cache, retrieves and searches in parallel, then streams a model answer with failover.

nodes.name: search_service.py
nodes.summary: Web search policy with TTL caching, a hard deadline, Tavily-to-Serper fallback, and parallel sub-queries for research mode.

nodes.name: cache.py
nodes.summary: Thread-safe in-process caches: a bounded TTL LRU cache and a per-scope cosine similarity cache of previous answers.
nodes.languageNotes: SemanticCache stores L2-normalized embeddings and only returns a hit inside the same scope tuple, so answers do not leak across users or a changed index.

nodes.name: sse.py
nodes.summary: Encodes a pipeline event dict as one Server-Sent Events frame with an event name and JSON data.

nodes.name: test_api.py
nodes.summary: Offline HTTP tests that exercise every API route, the SSE chat contract, uploads, search fallback, and rate limits.

nodes.name: test_live.py
nodes.summary: Opt-in live tests that measure real model streaming, hybrid retrieval quality, and Tavily latency against provider keys.
